title: Example plug-in
description: Lumiverb's example of a plug-in: it does nothing with your photos and videos yet, but shows how a plug-in runs, says what it reads, and how its settings look and are checked.
author: Lumiverb

settings.label: Caption
settings.help: A line it would show with each clip. Anything but "nothing": the plug-in checks that itself.

settings.label: Tag
settings.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, or nothing. Lumiverb checks the form before saving.

settings.label: Service key
settings.help: The server's, not an account's: only the server admin sees and sets it, and it's never shown again.
